Lantern Quay.name: Lantern Quay
Lantern Quay.basicInfo: A working harbor with a ferry landing, net lofts and a fish market.

ferry-landing.description: Wet planks and a bell that rings for every arrival.

market-hall.description: A long hall of stalls smelling of salt and citrus.

café-corner.description: Three tables and a steaming urn.

Lantern Quay.hiddenInfo: A sealed customs cellar runs under the market hall.

Salt Row.name: Salt Row
Salt Row.basicInfo: Narrow terraces above the quay where the guild families live.

guildhouse-steps.description: Worn steps where news is traded.

Dock Guild.name: Dock Guild
Dock Guild.basicInfo: Licensed porters and net-menders who run the quay.
Dock Guild.hiddenInfo: Skims a fee from every unlicensed ferry.

Harbor Master.name: Harbor Master
Harbor Master.visualDescription: A broad woman in an oilskin coat with a brass whistle.
Harbor Master.basicInfo: Logs every arrival in a battered ledger and answers in short sentences.

Net Mender.name: Net Mender
Net Mender.visualDescription: An elderly man with quick hands and a patched cap.
Net Mender.basicInfo: Mends nets at the end of the hall and hears everything.

ferry-bell.text:
Title: The Ferry Bell

The landing bell rings once per arrival and twice for a stranger.

dock-guild-fees.text:
Title: Dock Guild Fees

Every unlicensed crossing pays the guild a coin.

01 - Harbor Nights.name: 01 - Harbor Nights
01 - Harbor Nights.description: A courier arrives at Lantern Quay on the last ferry.
01 - Harbor Nights.storyStart: Day 1, Evening. You step off the last ferry onto Lantern Quay as the lamps come on.
